task-owner-changes.title: Assign task owner
task-owner-changes.intro: Choose one current person, preview the selected tasks, then confirm the change.
task-owner-changes.invalid_selection: Select between 1 and 16 loaded tasks with valid versions.
task-owner-changes.search_invalid: Use up to 200 characters without control characters.
task-owner-changes.no_people: No currently eligible people match. Try another search.
task-owner-changes.changed_facts: Task, owner or selection facts changed. Explicitly refresh the original selection and preview again; confirmation will be required again.
task-owner-changes.impact: Changed tasks return to In progress and their current acceptance qualification is cleared. Accepted dependent tasks may become invalid, and completed iterations or milestones may reopen. Existing runs, code, tests and review history are retained.
task-owner-changes.unchanged_impact: An unchanged owner receives no assignment update or notification, but that task can still be affected by a changed predecessor.
task-owner-changes.version_effect: The owner update increases this version. Dependency effects can increase it further; the receipt reports the actual final version.
task-owner-changes.unchanged_version_eff: No owner update is written. Dependency invalidation may still change this task's version or status.
task-owner-changes.no_changes: No owner changes. This preview cannot be applied.
task-owner-changes.acknowledge: I understand the acceptance and dependency effects and confirm this preview.
task-owner-changes.recovery_help: Keep the original selection, versions, preview and operation ID. Check this operation before starting another change.
task-owner-changes.storage_help: Local recovery information could not be read or saved. Resolve the storage issue and reopen this page before making a change; the original record is preserved.
task-owner-changes.saved_help: This is the original transaction receipt. Current task facts can change afterward.
task-owner-changes.refresh_failed: Current task refresh failed. The saved receipt remains confirmed; refresh the task list to read current facts.
task-owner-changes.access_changed: Access to this project changed. Private task and owner facts have been cleared.
task-owner-changes.access_check_invalid: Current project access could not be verified. The original operation is preserved.
task-owner-changes.target_unavailable: The selected person is not in the refreshed eligible page. Search or load more people and choose a current owner before previewing again.
task-owner-changes.invalid_read: The current task or people response could not be verified. No change was applied.
task-owner-changes.invalid_preview: The preview does not match the selected task versions and owner. No change was applied.
